commentary: The same character in every shot — **that's the part that used to break**

credit.name: u/8bitcollective
credit.note: posted to r/aivideo by the creator's own account

caption:
Spider-Man, if he were an actual man in 1970s Queens. Homemade suit, gut, moustache, a rope instead of webs, a cat in a tree instead of a supervillain.

Look past the joke at what is holding it together: it is the same character in every shot. Same face, same badly-stitched costume, same body, across six different setups and two lighting conditions.

That is the thing that was broken until recently. Making one convincing frame stopped being hard a while ago. Making the *next* shot contain the same person is what kept AI video stuck at "clip" instead of "scene" — faces drifted between cuts, and everyone quietly learned to shoot around it.

This is someone shooting straight at it. For a joke. In grainy 70s film stock.

Found at the source rather than three reposts downstream: by u/8bitcollective on r/aivideo — reddit.com/r/aivideo/comments/1vxncab
